evidence.evidence_text: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive natural language understanding capabilities across various text-based tasks, understanding humor has remained a persistent challenge.
We present an LLM with both the text and the spoken form of a joke, generated using an off-the-shelf text-to-speech (TTS) system.
